title: Tenant burst smoothing and fairness autotuner playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Summary: After a recent dedicated-cluster capacity incident caused by a tenant generating bursty traffic patterns, we need an operational and engineering playbook to reduce p95/p99 tail latency, prevent cascading evictions, and preserve fair throughput for healthy tenants. This ticket scopes a prototype autotuner that smooths tenant burst consumption via a PID-inspired token-bucket controller combined with adaptive reservation adjustments driven by EWMA of peak usage and spectral noise detection. The goal is to (1) contain noisy tenants quickly with graduated soft-fence throttles, (2) reduce eviction storms by smoothing reservation deltas, and (3) provide an automated rollback-safe rollout path with observable gates.
acceptance_criteria: Staging: p95 latency for co-located healthy tenants improves by >=15% under injected noisy tenant bursts compared to current baseline
Production-prereq: autoscaling and reservation-change events emit clear audit events and do not exceed 1% additional reservation churn during 24h canary
SLO preservation: no increase in customer-visible 5xx rate for dedicated customers during 48h canary
Operational: runbook for escalations and a one-click soft-fence action is documented and tested
Telemetry: dashboards showing tenant-level token-bucket fill, EWMA peak estimate, noise-score, and applied throttle level are live
tasks: Design controller: formalize PID-like smoothing parameters and define mapping from noise-score -> throttle tier
Telemetry: add tenant-level rolling windows for peak-rate EWMA and implement spectral analysis job (1m granularity)
Implementation: core token-bucket smoothing module and reservation delta limiter (C++ runtime + Go control-plane shim)
Testing: unit tests for controller math, integration tests in dedicated-staging with synthetic noisy clients
Canary: implement staged rollout with feature flag, 24h small-customer canary, 48h expanded canary
Runbook: write escalation steps, thresholds, and rollback playbook for Console / SRE
PRD update: link to confluence design and attach perf regression test plan
Cost analysis: estimate additional GPU utilization and expected unit-cost impact when smoothing is applied
